title: Researchers used Anthropic’s Claude to hack into OpenAI
summary: Security researchers used Anthropic’s Claude to exploit vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems, taking over employee accounts and gaining access to an internal code repository before reporting the flaws.
title_es: Investigadores usan Claude para hackear sistemas de OpenAI
bajada: Un equipo de investigadores de seguridad logró comprometer cuentas de empleados de OpenAI y acceder a repositorios internos usando Claude de Anthropic en menos de 72 horas. El incidente subraya vulnerabilidades críticas en los sistemas de seguridad de las principales compañías de IA.
bajada_en: Security researchers compromised OpenAI employee accounts and accessed internal repositories using Claude in less than 72 hours. The incident highlights critical vulnerabilities in the security systems of major AI companies.

title: Security researchers used Claude to help them hack into OpenAI
summary: A team of three independent security researchers at Hacktron says it took less than 72 hours for them to hack into OpenAI employee accounts using Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.8 and 5, the Wall Street Journal reports. They were able to access OpenAI's GitHub repository, called "Monorepo," which reportedly contains "OpenAI's algorithmic secrets," according to the […]
title_es: Meta lanza Muse en Mac con capacidad de automatizar acciones

bajada_en: Meta expands its AI tool Muse to macOS, allowing AI agents to work directly with user files and applications. This integration broadens the ecosystem of AI agents on desktop computers.

bajada: Anthropic relanza su función Projects en Claude Code, permitiendo ejecutar y coordinar múltiples agentes IA simultáneamente con memoria compartida y objetivos comunes. La característica facilita la gestión de flujos de trabajo complejos para developers.

title: Sep 17, 2026AnnouncementsIntroducing the Life Sciences Verification Program
summary: Announcements Introducing the Life Sciences Verification Program Sep 17, 2026 Today, we are introducing the Life Sciences Verification Program (LSVP), which gives life science professionals access to our Mythos, Opus, and Sonnet models with a refined set of safeguards more permissive for biology-related work. We have already onboarded dozens of organizations through an early-access program, and are now opening applications to the broader life science community ( apply here ). The program is launching in beta, initially for teams and institutions. We will continue to improve the program and expand access to individual Pro and Max plans over time. The LSVP is designed to enable life science professionals to use our models across a wide range of tasks that are currently blocked in our generally available Fable models, like drug discovery, research biology, clinical development, and manufacturing. It’s built for teams of all kinds—from academic labs to startups, pharma companies, and more. Verification and access types To qualify for these grants, each applicant goes through a verification process that includes a review of their research credentials, security standards, and ethical research oversight. Once verified, teams may apply for two types of LSVP grants, “Standard Use” or “High-risk Use,” depending on their access needs. These grants can be used through all our product surfaces, including Claude Science , Claude.ai , Claude Code and the API. Standard Use grants are suitable for most life science work, including the majority of biology research and development workflows. These grants can be extended to entire teams for diverse, daily workloads, and are renewed once a year. They give those teams access to our Mythos, Opus, and Sonnet models, with refined classifiers that are more permissive for science tasks than our generally available models. Standard Use grants apply to Mythos 5.1, Opus 5, and Sonnet 5 today, and to future models as they launch. They’re specific
title_es: Anthropic lanza programa de verificación para ciencias de la vida
bajada: Anthropic abre su Life Sciences Verification Program, dando acceso a investigadores y organizaciones de biología a versiones menos restrictivas de Claude. El programa permite aplicaciones previamente bloqueadas como descubrimiento de fármacos e investigación clínica.
bajada_en: Anthropic launches its Life Sciences Verification Program, granting researchers and biology organizations access to less restrictive Claude versions. The program enables previously blocked applications like drug discovery and clinical research.

title: AI Safety Push Sparks Demand for Watchdog Groups. Critics Doubt Their Independence.
summary: Rising alarm about AI’s perils is thrusting into the spotlight a collection of little-known research groups focused on the technology’s safety—and fueling questions about their ability to effectively monitor the industry’s biggest companies.BothAnthropicChief Executive Dario Amodei andOpenAICEO Sam Altman promised in recent days to embed evaluators from such outside research organizations inside their companies to help ensure they develop AI at a safe pace. Other executives includingMicrosoft CEO Satya Nadellaalso endorsed the idea of embedding independent evaluators in companies.
title_es: Crecen dudas sobre independencia de evaluadores de IA
bajada: CEOs de Anthropic y OpenAI prometieron incrustar evaluadores independientes en sus compañías, pero expertos cuestionan su verdadera autonomía. El debate refleja tensiones entre la autorregulación de la industria y la supervisión externa genuina.
bajada_en: CEOs of Anthropic and OpenAI promised to embed independent evaluators in their companies, but experts question their true autonomy. The debate reflects tensions between industry self-regulation and genuine external oversight.

title: If the AI Industry Followed Its Own Research, It Might Have Paused Already
summary: Anthropic’s CEO says that safety hinges on understanding how AI “thinks.” So far the evidence is disturbing.
title_es: La industria de IA ignora su propia investigación sobre seguridad
bajada: Según el CEO de Anthropic, la industria no sigue sus propios hallazgos de investigación sobre la importancia de pausar el desarrollo de IA. El análisis subraya la brecha entre lo que los investigadores recomiendan y lo que las empresas implementan.

bajada: CEOs de principales compañías de IA alertan sobre el riesgo de que la tecnología se use para crear bioarmas. Las advertencias generan debates sobre cómo ralentizar responsablemente el progreso mientras se mitigan riesgos existenciales.

title: Napster Is Back, and It Wants to Digitally Clone Teachers
summary: Once the music industry’s biggest headache, Napster’s next act is bringing AI to the classroom.
title_es: Napster regresa para clonar digitalmente a maestros con IA
bajada: La plataforma musical Napster anuncia su entrada en educación usando IA para crear versiones digitales de docentes. El proyecto genera debates sobre privacidad, consentimiento y el futuro de la educación personalizada.
bajada_en: Napster announces entry into education using AI to create digital teacher clones. The project sparks debates about privacy, consent, and the future of personalized learning.

title: AI PACs Have Dumped Nearly $1 Million Into an Obscure Senate Race
summary: The reliably Republican South Dakota senate seat has an incumbent on the ballot. But PACs associated with AI labs and investors have already spent more money on the race than actual residents have.
title_es: PACs de IA gastan casi $1M en carrera senatorial oscura
bajada: Grupos de apoyo vinculados a laboratorios de IA han invertido cifras significativas en una carrera electoral senatorial poco conocida. El movimiento revela el creciente intento de influencia política del sector tecnológico de IA.
bajada_en: Political action committees linked to AI labs have invested significantly in an obscure Senate race. The move reveals the growing political influence efforts of the AI tech sector.
